name: Swoop Gizzard
summary: Across Mulgore, swoops soar as predatory birds, and their gizzards go into traditional remedies for deadly toxins.

sections.title: A Rare Folk Ingredient
sections.body: Swoops hunt across Mulgore’s plains and mesas, with keen eyes and a taste for scavenging. Tauren use their feathers and meat in daily life, while herbalists and healers prize their internal organs, especially the gizzard. Dense and muscular, it helps counter venomous bites and festering infections when combined with cougar bones and wolf hearts.

sections.title: A Remedy for Mazzranache's Bite
sections.body: In Bloodhoof Village, Maur Raincaller tends the wound Mazzranache left on his shoulder. The legendary plainstrider’s venom drives Maur into delirium as the poison creeps through him. To make a poultice that can expel the lethal venom, Maur needs a swoop gizzard, a prairie wolf heart, a flatland cougar femur, and a plainstrider scale.

faq.q: What is a swoop gizzard used for?
aliases: why do i need swoop gizzard
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village needs a swoop gizzard as an essential ingredient in a remedy. Mixed with three other animal parts, it forms a cure for the venomous infection left by Mazzranache, the vicious plainstrider.

faq.q: Where do swoop gizzards come from?
faq.answer: Swoop gizzards come from the swoops gliding over Mulgore’s plains, including standard swoops, wiry swoops, and taloned swoops.

faq.q: Why does Maur Raincaller need this specific part?
faq.answer: Mazzranache bit Maur, and the unusually ferocious plainstrider’s venom brings raging fevers and nightmares. Tauren folk medicine uses potent animal parts, including a gizzard, to counter the toxins in Maur’s veins.

faq.q: Is the gizzard used for anything other than Maur's cure?
faq.answer: No. Beyond Maur Raincaller’s specialized folk remedy in Bloodhoof Village, swoop gizzards have no standard culinary, alchemical, or crafting use.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter or shaman, gathering these parts honors the tradition of using Mulgore’s wildlife to sustain and heal the tribe.
